verdict_reason: The final packet is an honest blocked-result handback under the explicit D1 stop rule. The D2/C1/C2 omissions are intentional dependencies, and no current primary code-review finding remains. This verdict accepts the evidence packet for review, not the board model, bench, assembly, fabrication, or energization.

Preserve the D1 stop rule and hold D2/C1/C2 board-grid claims until an accepted extracted matrix exists. Review archive integrity, evidence provenance, and safety claims against the staged packet and ROUND-5.md.

The hot diode and switching-loss comparison depends on D1/C1; the packet holds it.
The no-mains double-pulse procedure covers both leg-A switches, staged bus/current points, synchronized measurements, discharge and stop conditions. No bench run is claimed.
The packet records sourcing candidates, related-board outer-land checks, and round-3/round-4 raw-evidence publication without assembly or fabrication approval.
The packet states the evidence class, native-17 board hash, ignored local raw manifest and replay instructions, blocker, and cheapest next diagnostic step.
